Data:Slnev.serena.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Serena asks Denzil about the work that his father did for Governor Collers of the Cucurbit. Denzil replies briefly, but politely. It is plain that neither of them much liked Collers. [Lesson: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]

Data:Slnev.serena.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Serena knew Mr Kille as an 'untidy youth' in Brancrug just after the Great War. She shares some of her memories with Mrs Kille, who listens closely and smiles fondly, though she does not laugh. (It is not easy to make Mrs Kille laugh.) Serena asks if Mr Kille ever speaks of her, but Mrs Kille says no; she says that she thinks Mr Kille is still a little frightened of her. 'Silence after lightning; silence before thunder,' she observes, and Serena looks at her sidelong.

Data:Slnev.serena.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Timothy barrages Serena with questions about the architecture of Hush House, and the changes she notices since her time here. She answers the more innocuous questions and steers him away from the more difficult ones. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.serena.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette is considering keeping her notes in houndsgall, for safety. Serena advises her on some of the dangers of houndsgall use and storage. [Lesson: Inks of Containment]

Data:Slnev.serena.zachary.json.startdescription: Zachary asks Serena about the Wheelocks of Treowen and in particular poor doomed Gregory, the 'demi-dyad'; but they conclude that nothing in that sad story will help Zachary. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.agdistis.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Agdistis discuss pruning techniques used when a plant is wounded by winter; how to ensure no ragged bark remains; of how not to be distracted by timidity or tenderness. [Lesson: Leaves & Thorns]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.aladim.json.startdescription: Towards the end of the meal, Father Stanislav demonstrates some of the signs that he used to communicate with 'singlefoots' in his travels 'east of Hsian'. He draws the signs on his plate, and wipes them away afterwards. 'Safer not,' he says quietly, 'unless you wanted to stay east of Hsian.' [Lesson: Cracktrack]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.arthur.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Arthur discuss the herbs of Persia, and their uses in the infirmary of the Labyrinth of Lions. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.arun.json.startdescription: Stanislav speaks of a provoking line on the White Jade Tablet -  'our skins were yet soft, and fell easily from us…' He wonders how Peel's own 'shedding' might be related, but Peel is typically evasive. [Lesson: Rites of the Roots]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.azita.json.startdescription: Azita asks Stanislav's opinion on the 'lignifying plague' she recently observed in Kabul and Samarkand, which only affects buildings - so far… [Lesson: Rites of the Roots]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.chaima.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Chaima speak of the Seven-Coiled, the 'Father of the Mother', who has passed from the world; of the seven unhuman acolytes she has inspired; of their prophecies. Chaima reflects wistfully on what a great hunt the end of the Seven-Coiled might have been... [Lesson: Sand Stories]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.connie.json.startdescription: Stanislav confirms to Connie that he, too, has now heard something of the 'Spinnennebel' which first appeared in Austria but has  afflicted remote parts of the countryside across Europe - even as far west as his sanctuary in Brittany. He agrees that it has many of the hallmarks of a Nowhere irruption - but adds thoughtfully that one informant claims it's been manufactured... [Lesson: Insects & Nectars]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.coquille.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Coquille swap stories of Aunt Mopsy. He met her when she made a pilgrimage to the Grove of Green Immortals, in the days he dwelt in its penumbra; she introduced him to her adoptive brother in Tiflis when his tastes had become jaded and he sought more dangerous diversions... [Lesson: Leaves & Thorns]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.corso.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Corso speak of Zulfiya Zakirova, to whom Corso was once very nearly married - by Stanislav, in fact. Corso tugs miserably at his moustache as he describes her struggles with deliria and her obsession with the whimsies of the Wood. 'Then one day she started wearing wigs and ran off with a piano-tuner. Last I heard she was giving piano lessons in Leipzig.' [Lesson: Orchids & Narcotics]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.dagmar.json.startdescription: Stanislav gives bee-keeping advice to Dagmar. The hives on her estate, she informs him, have been 'slacking off'. [Lesson: Insects & Nectars]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas has been looking into the six-centuries-past death of Abbess Nonna. He's questioned unspecified sources that he doesn't share with Stanislav, and concludes that Nonna was possessed by a Name of the Blackbone and 'put down' by her sistren - 'nasty business, but best thing for it.' He and Stanislav discuss the herb-mixtures that might have laid her open to that possession. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.ehsan.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Ehsan debate which rivers and weathers may still qualify - metaphorically or prophetically - at which times and seasons - as the 'blood of the Seven-Coils'. [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.fraser.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Fraser discuss the work of the entomologist Juliana Zawistowski. Fraser is firmly of the belief that she bore within her the nature of the Thritige-kind of the Carapace Cross. [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.hokobald.json.startdescription: Stanislav asks Hokobald about the tradition that the Velvet makes immortals of those sufficiently savorous to be hunted by her pet, Kitling Ripe. Hokobald confidently confirms that it's so, but his explanations are derailed by rants about those immortals who should have become her victims - or who she devoured despite their blandness. (He sounds almost jealous of these last.) [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.morgen.json.startdescription: Morgen presses Stanislav further on 'Three Faces', the Applebright-Name associated with the Grove of Green Immortals. Stanislav asks if Morgen and Three Faces are 'professionally acquainted'; Morgen says that they are not - yet - and that she may yet ask Stanislav to provide an introduction. Stanislav doesn't seem enthusiastic about the prospect. [Lesson: Orchids & Narcotics]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.olympe.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Olympe discuss the Hours of the Wood. Stanislav points out that monks cut their hair; he suggests, perhaps mischievously, that as a class they belong to the Moth… [Lesson: Rites of the Roots]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.serena.json.startdescription: Serena answers Stanislav's questions about the kitchens of the Serapeum during her time there - in particular about the Westcottian techniques she brought from Brancrug. [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.visiting.denzil.jso.startdescription: Denzil gives Stanislav what advice he can muster on warding off rust. [Lesson: Putrefactions & Calcinations]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.visiting.killes.jso.startdescription: Stanislav and Mr Kille discuss Mr Kille's marrows. Stanislav appears to be in honest awe of Mr Kille's marrows. [Lesson: Herbs & Infusions]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.visiting.timothy.js.startdescription: Stanislav and Timothy share gossip about doctrinal and political differences between the Church establishment on the Continent, and its sister denomination in Britain. Stanislav leans back in his chair, eyes half-closed, chuckling now and then; Timothy is so delighted and clearly feels so guilty that his teeth are chattering a little. [Lesson: Sacra Solis Invicti]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.yvette.json.startdescription: Yvette questions Stanislav about the Carniolan Heresy, which perceived the Moon as a chrysalis and the Sun as its imago. Stanislav is entertaining on the details of the heresy, but finds himself unable to enlighten Yvette on its motives and origins.  [Lesson: Insects & Nectars]

Data:Slnev.stanislav.zachary.json.startdescription: Stanislav and Zachary discuss the 'merciful measures' of the witch Nyn. Zachary agrees that her techniques are potent against Devourers, but he has become unwilling to use them since he began to fear that he himself might qualify as a Devourer… [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.aladim.json.startdescription: Al-Adim is asking Denzil technical questions about farriery. ('I have ridden many kinds of steed on many kinds of highway…') Denzil answers briefly and gravely, but his interest does seem piqued by al-Adim's hints about shoeing other steeds than horses… [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.arthur.json.startdescription: Arthur is asking Denzil about his time in the War. Denzil replies in courteous monosyllables. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.arun.json.startdescription: Arun begins an animated, if one-sided, conversation with Denzil, treating him to an impromptu translation of the Incandescent Tantra: 'a great change requires a melting dissolution.' Arun's tone becomes more sibilant, and he sits very close to Denzil, who begins, cautiously, to smile. [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.azita.json.startdescription: Azita describes skirmishes with bandits and customs guards along the roads of the East. Denzil sits with his arms folded, nodding occasionally. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.chaima.json.startdescription: Denzil and Chaima sit companionably together as she demonstrates alarming tricks with her knife. [Lesson: Sharps]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.connie.json.startdescription: Connie is questioning Denzil, apparently casually, about recent dreams in which he has followed a great winged beast through a dark wood. Denzil replies concisely, but frankly. [Lesson: Horns & Ivories]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.coquille.json.startdescription: Coquille is asking Denzil to describe the storms of the coast to her. She leans close and smiles at him from beneath her lashes. Denzil does not engage, except to complain about a recent storm that closed the Sweet Bones. Eventually he does speak of an incident of 'St Piran's candles' - a light that sometimes plays around the rectory weathercock in storms - but his detached, practical description plainly fails to satisfy Coquille. [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.corso.json.startdescription: Corso asks Denzil about the coastal paths, and those he's seen walking them. Smugglers? Pilgrims? Ghosts? Denzil shakes his head to all of those, but he does describe an encounter his great-grandfather supposedly had with a 'woman from behind the wave'... [Lesson: Path & Pilgrim]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.dagmar.json.startdescription: Dagmar is explaining to Denzil how he's going to move out to become her resident smith and help with 'lots of little projects'. Denzil intermittently affirms that he's not going to do anything of the kind. Dagmar doesn't seem to notice, or at least doesn't seem to mind. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.douglas.json.startdescription: Douglas asks Denzil for advice on repairs to his shed, which Denzil gravely provides. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.ehsan.json.startdescription: Ehsan and Denzil chat about fishing. [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser quizzes Denzil on his recollections of Cornish tin-mining. Denzil's family, it seems, included a number of tinners. 'Not many as do die old,' Denzil allows. [Lesson: Coil & Chasm]

Data:Slnev.visiting.denzil.hokobald.json.startdescription: Hokobald presses Denzil on the coastal tales of the deep bells of Ys. Denzil grudgingly shares scraps gleaned from his father. [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]
